title: PDF export alignment: Type centered, text left, numeric and money right
refs: SV-8646 (PV spec v10 2026-08-17 S6-R10; S3-R8; SV-8823 S6-R10 PDF-only; SV-8818 PDF export 500)
preconds: 1. You are on the Parts Velocity report with data loaded and several columns of each kind visible..
steps:
1. Download the PDF and look at the alignment of each column.
2. Download the CSV and open it in a plain text editor to confirm it is plain comma-separated values (a CSV file carries no alignment of its own).
expected:
1. In the PDF, the Type column is CENTERED.
2. In the PDF, the text columns (Part #, Description, Category, Vendor) are left-aligned.
3. In the PDF, EVERY numeric and money column is right-aligned.
4. This alignment / bold / colour treatment (S6-R10) is now a PDF-ONLY treatment — the on-screen table is all-left-aligned and the CSV is plain data with no alignment; the difference is documented, not a defect.
5. The CSV carries no alignment, bold or colour at all; how a spreadsheet displays the CSV is not part of this test.

What you should see today: downloading the PDF returns a server error instead of a PDF (the export fails with an error message). This is a known problem and it is already reported — see https://shopview.atlassian.net/browse/SV-8818.
· If you see exactly that, mark this test FAILED and do not raise anything new.
· If the PDF downloads but the column alignment differs from items 1–3 above, that is a DIFFERENT problem — please report it.
· If the PDF downloads and the alignment is exactly as items 1–3 describe, the fix has shipped: tell the QA lead so the ticket can be closed and this note removed.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582 and the Parts Velocity report specification version 11 (updated 17 August 2026, S6-R10, S3-R8; S6-R10 scoped to the PDF only per the Dipesh correction on SV-8823).
Last checked against build v3.8-d0e135e on 8/20/2026 — CSV confirmed plain (no formatting); PDF export returned HTTP 500 (SV-8818), so PDF alignment could not be re-rendered this pass.
Re-checked against the live specification on 28 August 2026: every requirement this case cites was read again in the live version and the behaviour above still matches it, so only the version cited above was updated.

AUTOMATION: READY - EXPECT FAIL (SV-8818)
